type.description: Define the type of the credentials

url.description: Define the url of the credentials In some cases, such as when using an IP instead of a hostname, it might be

region.description: Override the region to use when connecting to the endpoint Setting this manually is usually not necessary as the region should normally

name.description: Define the secret name This will be automatically expanded to `fullname-secret-name`.

key.description: Define the key in the secret data containing the CA

expandObjectName.description: Whether to expand (adding the fullname as prefix) the secret name

customCASecretRef.description: Reference a secret containing a custom CA to be used when connecting to the endpoint defined by `url` over HTTPS.

customCA.description: Define a custom CA certificate to be used when connecting to the endpoint defined by `url` over HTTPS.

path.description: Define the optional path-override of the credentials

bucket.description: Define the bucket of the credentials

accessKey.description: Define the accessKey of the credentials

secretKey.description: Define the secretKey of the credentials
